pillars.title: Smart Energy Systems
pillars.lede: How renewable generation is forecast, dispatched, and kept resilient — from a single building to the grid.

clusters.title: Energy Forecasting
clusters.description: Machine-learning forecasts of renewable generation: solar output predicted from satellite cloud imagery, and short-term wind forecasting that schedules green-hydrogen production (with MIRDC).

clusters.title: Microgrid Design & Resilience
clusters.description: Network-design frameworks that minimize cost and line losses, and storage strategies that keep microgrids running through extreme weather — including the Beitou–Shilin Technology Park microgrid as a living case study.

clusters.title: Energy Dispatch & Storage Strategy
clusters.description: Optimization models for multi-site energy storage that fold in real building demand and cost, comparing stochastic and deterministic dispatch — plus the economics of hydrogen fuel cells.

clusters.title: Investment Strategy & Evaluation
clusters.description: What storage and V2X are actually worth: benefit evaluation grounded in weather, electricity-market structure, and site type, supported by campus-scale electricity-use simulation.

pillars.title: Low-Carbon Transport & Supply Chains
pillars.lede: Cutting carbon where freight moves and fuels are made.

clusters.title: Logistics Network Design
clusters.description: How low-carbon freight systems are architected: network structure and transshipment scheduling that move goods with fewer vehicles, fewer kilometers, and less carbon.

clusters.title: EV Charger Siting
clusters.description: Where charging infrastructure should go: siting and sizing chargers for electric fleets and logistics hubs so operations keep running while grids stay within limits.

clusters.title: Vehicle Routing
clusters.description: Emission-aware routing for last-mile and cold-chain delivery, balancing delivery windows, temperature requirements, and carbon in one optimization.

clusters.title: Warehouse Operations
clusters.description: The carbon footprint of warehousing across its life cycle, and how digital transformation redistributes emissions between warehouses and transport.

clusters.title: Alternative Fuels
clusters.description: Life-cycle and techno-economic assessment of the fuels set to replace oil in shipping and aviation: marine alternative fuels and sustainable aviation fuel pathways (power-to-liquid and HEFA).

pillars.title: Sustainable Energy Decision-Making
pillars.lede: Data-driven evaluation of energy-transition strategies — their environmental, economic, and public-health consequences.

clusters.title: Policy Evaluation
clusters.description: Econometric and quasi-experimental evidence on what transition policies actually deliver: isolating the real decarbonization effects of infrastructure and policy interventions, rather than assuming them.

clusters.title: Environment & Health
clusters.description: Tracing energy and emission scenarios through to air quality and public-health outcomes, so policies are judged by their full downstream consequences.

clusters.title: Green Finance
clusters.description: How capital flows to the transition: financing instruments and investment signals that move decarbonization from plan to balance sheet.

clusters.title: Transport Safety
clusters.description: The safety dimension of changing mobility systems, analyzed with the same data-driven rigor the center applies to emissions.
